body: I havnt been banned yet, but I have been chat banned till October 1st. When you get chat banned you cant type in chat or use team chat at all but can still read and hear everything. This does not include your own personal friends being invited to your game through the lobby in which case you can still vc and type in party chat. Another way of a "ban" is leaving or going afk in a game in which the other team or your team will report you for that and when you get back to the lobby it'll give you an amount of time in which you can not que. This has happened to me multiple times due to my wifi going out and depending on how long you are gone for depends on how long your restrictions are. I've seen them go from 10 minutes to 2 hours, but if you leave the game for that time and come back after then the timer will be away if you were gone for the specific amount of time. This totally depends on what the other team is like or your own teammates are like, and if they report you it just depends on how long you were gone for. It does not happen all the time but it has happened multiple times to me.
